question: Can the intended three-engine turning production path construct one genuine native world per advertised engine, issue a nonzero canonical turning command, step real physics, finalize and retain a complete trace through CAS, assemble exact terminals, and invoke the route evaluator without an infrastructure-invalid or incomplete result?

canonical_semantics.host_mapping_rule: canonical policy output is mapped only by the selected native adapter

development_ghost.seed_provenance: Previously outcome-exposed and consumed by the closed R23D60 Godot/Jolt finite decision; deliberately reused only for non-authoritative route development so no fresh held-out seed is consumed.

included: the real production entry and worker for each advertised engine
genuine Godot/Jolt, Rapier/Parry, and MuJoCo world construction
public selected actuator-cap profile resolution and native binding
canonical controller invocation with a nonzero positive-heading command
two real controller-semantic physics steps per engine
native actuator application and readback accounting
canonical NDJSON serialization and content-addressed publication
excluded: late phase transitions, full-volume buffering, and timeout behavior
behavioral success, repeatability, robustness, or population inference
QSDK-R23, physical acceptance, or release authority
coverage_manifest.adequacy_argument: One positive-heading cell in each of the three advertised native engines is the complete engine population for the integration question. Two controller steps are the smallest horizon that issues and applies a nonzero command, records more than an initialization row, reaches normal horizon finalization, publishes a complete trace, and permits terminal aggregation and evaluation. No named route risk depends on a second seed or on later schedule volume. Any later-discovered late or volume-dependent risk requires an additional targeted ghost before held-out freeze.

route_integrity_thresholds.provenance: Structural production-route invariants derived directly from the declared two-step, three-engine development configuration; no observed physics outcome or behavioral threshold is used.
